title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Installment Plan Setup Fee
content:
**Fee schedule — lease-end installment plan setup fee, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

| Payments on the lease ever returned | Plan setup fee |
|---|---|
| none | waived ($0) |
| exactly one | $15 (the reduced plan setup fee) |
| two or more | $35 (the standard plan setup fee) |

**Terms.** The plan setup fee is waived when no payment on the lease was ever returned, is the reduced plan setup fee when exactly one payment on the lease was returned, and is the standard plan setup fee when two or more were. A returned payment is a payment on the lease that was dishonoured and reversed, counted over the life of the lease whatever the bank's reason. The setup fee is added last, to the first installment.

**Hypothetical illustrations**

- A lease whose payments were never returned opens its plan with no setup fee in the first installment.
- A lease with one returned payment adds $15 to the first installment; with three returned payments it adds $35.
